_note: Grep gate for the public accounting article (jqrgencorp-regnskap) only. This page may name Folio (as a product), Fiken, MVA and privat uttak, so the shared forbidden-terms.json is not used here; this list covers what must never appear: counterparties, other banks, crypto exchanges, company numbers, currency amounts, health words. Case-insensitive substring match. Extend freely; never weaken a term to dodge a false positive, change the text instead. build-jqrgencorp-regnskap.js also runs a digit check (amount- and invoice-number-like digits) on the visible text.
